requirements.text: * Proficiency in Python and modern JavaScript/TypeScript, with production experience on both the server and client sides of an application.
* Experience building and operating backend services and scheduled or orchestrated jobs on cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Understanding of sports betting markets — odds, line movement, limits, player props, and market maker behavior — and of basketball data such as play\-by\-play, box score, and tracking data.
* Strong SQL skills and familiarity with relational data modeling and cloud data warehouses such as Snowflake.
* Experience with a modern front\-end framework and demonstrated ability to design usable interfaces for analytical or investigative workflows.
* Familiarity with Git\-based development workflows (GitHub or Azure DevOps), CI/CD, containerization (Docker), and automated testing.
* Experience integrating third\-party APIs and building robust applications around external services with evolving, incomplete, or inconsistent data.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with non\-technical stakeholders, including attorneys and investigators.
* Sound judgment and discretion in handling confidential and legally sensitive information.
* Confident individual, able to work in a fast\-paced environment and manage short\-term deliverables along with long\-term projects.
* Excels when working as part of a team, collaborating effectively both within BSG Integrity and cross\-functionally.
* Experience with Airflow or a comparable orchestration and scheduling platform.
* Experience with Databricks, including Spark, Delta Lake, or Unity Catalog.
* Working knowledge of applied machine learning and experience integrating model inference into production applications.
* Experience building LLM\-based applications (retrieval, summarization, or agentic workflows), particularly for document\-heavy or investigative use cases.
* Familiarity with graph databases and graph\-based data modeling; experience with Amazon Neptune or a comparable graph database is a plus.
* Experience integrating open\-source intelligence or third\-party intelligence services into production applications.
* Experience with data visualization libraries and dashboard design.
* Prior work on integrity, surveillance, fraud, AML, or trust and safety systems is a plus.
* Experience in sports, gaming, or another regulated or compliance\-driven environment is a plus.
* Bachelor’s degree required in computer science, engineering, mathematics, statistics, or a related technical field; master’s degree preferred.
* Bachelor’s degree required in computer science, engineering, mathematics, statistics, or a related technical field; master’s degree preferred.
* Minimum 5 years of professional software engineering experience, including experience developing production backend or full\-stack applications.
